services.name: Midday Fishing
services.desc: You choose either a two or four-hour cruise and what you would like to do -- fishing, cruising, site seeing, touring the area by water, we can provide it all. Private cruises are perfect for weddings, parties, birthdays, large groups that would prefer to sail together, family reunions, the list is endless. Everyone has a great time aboard the Miss Oregon Inlet II. We can easily accommodate large parties of 49 or more! Enjoy a half day of Outer Banks fishing or an evening sunset cruise! On either trip, you will see nature at its best! Sea turtles, porpoises, pelicans and so much more! Powered by the OneBoat® Community Content Management System. blurb: Guests join fishing trips aboard a 60-foot head boat that can hold up to 65 people. The boat runs three trips a day from May 1st to October 31st. Private charters and parties are also available with an enclosed cabin for entertaining.
extraNote: 48-hour cancellation policy; full price charged if canceled less than 48 hours before trip · Full refund for trips canceled due to weather · Oregon Inlet Fishing Center, 8770 Oregon Inlet Road, Nags Head, NC 27959 · May 1st to October 31st
